issues.quote: lifting R&D expense to $12.9 billion in fiscal 2025 from $8.7 million in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit: fiscal 2024 R&D was about $8.7 billion ($8.675B), not $8.7 million. The actual increase was about 49%.

data.summary: The revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS and margin figures match NVIDIA's reported FY2025 and FY2024 results. The one error is fiscal 2024 R&D, given as $8.7 million instead of $8.7 billion.
